# PolkaMeter

> PolkaMeter is a Rust CLI for load and stress tests on Polkadot SDK chains. XML plans set the rates, plugins prepare transactions, and a load test ends with a verdict (PASS, WARN, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE). Results include samples in JMeter's CSV format. The substrate plugin loads chains with the standard System and Balances pallets and compatible signing types without custom code. Calls mode (`polkameter calls`) loads a chain with calls from a polkadot-api call file, without writing a plan or plugin, and ends PASS, FAIL or CANNOT TELL.

## Tutorials

- [Getting started](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/getting-started.html): install, start a dev chain, load it past a limit, and generate a plan for your chain
- [Writing a plugin](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/writing-a-plugin.html): build, install and run a plugin with one operation

## How-to guides

- [Install](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/install.html): every install method, supported platforms and version pinning
- [Run in CI](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/ci.html): the GitHub Action, GitLab CI and other CI systems
- [Calls mode](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/calls-mode.html): `polkameter calls`, a load test from a polkadot-api call file, without writing a plan or plugin
- [Read the results](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/reading-results.html): verdict, failure onset, max sustained rate, loss check, recovery, stop rules
- [Use PolkaMeter with an AI assistant](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/ai-assistants.html): the PolkaMeter skill
- [Troubleshooting](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/troubleshooting.html): common errors and fixes

## Explanation

- [Less code, same correctness](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/less-code.html): calls mode against plain polkadot-api on nine real chains, median 43 lines against 309, both audited correct

## Reference

- [Plan](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/plans.html): every plan element and attribute
- [CLI](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/cli.html): commands, exit codes, environment variables
- [Run directory](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/results.html): every file a run writes
- [Plugin reference](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/plugins.html): plugin protocol, manifest, PreparedTx, the polkameter-plugin-sdk crate
- [The substrate plugin](https://agustinustheodorus.com/polkameter/substrate-plugin.html): its operations, inputs and outputs

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/agustinustheo/polkameter): the code and example plans in `examples/`
- [Examples](https://github.com/agustinustheo/polkameter/tree/main/examples): calls-mode tests of nine real chains next to the plain polkadot-api tests they replace
- [PolkaMeter skill](https://github.com/agustinustheo/polkameter/tree/main/skills/polkameter): SKILL.md, plan and CI templates
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/agustinustheo/polkameter/blob/main/AGENTS.md): build and test commands for contributors
